full.description: This image is a gross pathology photograph showing a cross-section of a lung specimen. The lung tissue displays numerous scattered, pale, whitish-yellow nodular lesions and areas of fibrosis surrounding dilated bronchi. These findings are characteristic of diffuse pulmonary involvement, most commonly associated with chronic suppurative or granulomatous conditions such as tuberculosis or fungal infections.

random.description: This image shows a gross pathology specimen of a lung cut section. The lung tissue displays numerous whitish, yellowish nodular lesions distributed throughout the parenchyma. These findings are characteristic of miliary tuberculosis, demonstrating widespread dissemination of granulomatous infection. The airways and surrounding lung architecture are visibly altered by the numerous foci of disease.
